Initial release of Kujiale Design Tool Free Version:

- Step-by-step interior design tool supporting floor plan confirmation, style selection, furniture layout, and rendering for personal users.
- Enables searches by community name or by uploading floor plan images for smart identification.
- Supports basic hard furnishing style options, automatic layout, standard-quality rendering, and 360° panoramic image generation.
- Designed for quick renovation scheme previews, inspiration exploration, and beginner-friendly operation without professional software experience.
- Requires Node.js 16+, a valid access_token, and command-line interface usage; integrates with Kujiale design platform API.
